units.title: Strand A: Introduction, Events and Developments

subtopics.title: The first humans and the prophets

outcomes.text: State that the first human was a Muslim and that his belief began with the oneness of God.
Introduce the prophets from Adam to Muhammad in order and briefly tell about them.
Describe the settlement of humans on earth and their beliefs.

topics.title: Arabia and neighbouring lands before Islam

subtopics.title: Political and social conditions before Islam

outcomes.text: Understand the political conditions of Arabia and neighbouring lands (Iran, Rome, Egypt, Abyssinia) before Islam.
Describe the religious, social and cultural conditions of Arabs and other nations.
Introduce the eloquence and poetry of the Arabs.
Locate Arabia and its neighbours on a world map.
Describe the Prophet's birth and early life.
Narrate the first revelation and the start of the open call.
Draw patience and steadfastness as lessons from his life.

subtopics.title: Hardships and migration to Abyssinia and Taif

outcomes.text: Recount key events of the Makkan period, the migration to Abyssinia and the journey to Taif.
Summarise the main points of the Prophet's call in Makkah.
Put events of the Makkan life in time order and name five well-known books of his biography.

subtopics.title: Hijrah and the Constitution of Madinah

outcomes.text: Comment on the importance and effects of the Hijrah.
Describe building the Prophet's Mosque and the Charter of Madinah.
Comment on forming Islamic society and state in Madinah.

subtopics.title: The battles and the Farewell Pilgrimage

outcomes.text: Discuss causes, events and results of Badr, Uhud, the Trench, Khaybar and the conquest of Makkah.
Describe the Farewell Pilgrimage and summarise its sermon.
Assess the Prophet's political strategy in Madinah.

units.title: Strand B: System of Government and Administration

outcomes.text: Describe government and administration in the Prophet's time.
Describe the sources of state income.
Name officials, zakat collectors and commanders he appointed.
Explain the Prophet's judicial decisions.
Define Islamic civilisation.
Describe how Islamic civilisation was founded and developed in the Prophet's time, with its main features.
Discuss the role and activities of women in his time.
Review the activities and responsibilities of slaves and subject classes.

units.title: Strand D: Growth of Knowledge and Arts

topics.title: Knowledge and arts in the Prophet's time

outcomes.text: Review the development of knowledge and arts in the Prophet's time.
Describe educational activities of his time.

units.title: Strand A: Introduction, Events and Developments

outcomes.text: Introduce the Rightly-Guided Caliphate.
Explain the meaning of caliphate.
Distinguish the caliphate from other systems of government.
Describe Abu Bakr's life and his selection as caliph.
Explain the difficulties of his caliphate and how they were overcome.
Discuss the wars and conquests of his time and his major services.
Discuss his character and compare him as a ruler with present-day rulers.
Describe Umar's early life.
Describe the conquests of his caliphate.
Explain his style of governing and his services.
Describe Uthman's early life and his selection as caliph.
Describe the Islamic conquests in his caliphate.
Discuss his character and analyse his martyrdom.
Describe Ali's early life and his services to Islam.
Discuss the difficulties of his caliphate and how he dealt with them.
Discuss his style of governing and his character.
Describe Hasan's life and his role in uniting Muslims.
Describe Muawiyah's life and rule.
Analyse the event of Karbala and the martyrdom of Husayn.
Describe Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan and show he was the real founder of the later Umayyad state.
Discuss the conquests and borders of the empire under Walid ibn Abd al-Malik.
Comment on the reign of Hisham and review the services of Sulayman.
Describe the life, character and rule of Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz and its effects.
Briefly cover other Umayyad rulers and analyse the causes of the Umayyad decline.

units.title: Strand B: System of Government and Administration

topics.title: Government in the Rightly-Guided and Umayyad periods

outcomes.text: Explain the concept of caliphate in light of the Quran and Sunnah.
Introduce the Islamic political system.
Review the administrative institutions of the Rightly-Guided Caliphate.
Distinguish a caliph from an ordinary ruler.
Discuss the distinguishing features of the Rightly-Guided Caliphate.
Review government and administration under the Umayyads.
Compare Umayyad government with the Rightly-Guided Caliphate.
Discuss Islamic civilisation and its features in the Rightly-Guided and Umayyad periods.
Discuss the role and standing of women in those periods.

units.title: Strand D: Growth of Knowledge and Arts

topics.title: Knowledge and arts in these periods

outcomes.text: Discuss the patronage of learning by the Rightly-Guided Caliphs.
Review the progress of knowledge and arts under the Umayyads.
Introduce the main scholars of the Umayyad period.

units.title: Strand A: Introduction, Events and Developments

outcomes.text: Briefly review the early Islamic period.
Discuss the beginning and growth of the Abbasid movement that led to the caliphate.
Describe the role of Abu Muslim Khurasani in ending the Umayyads.
Introduce Abul Abbas al-Saffah and the conditions in which he founded the Abbasid caliphate.
Review his conquests.
Introduce al-Mansur and review his character and achievements as caliph.
Review his claim to be the true Abbasid founder and compare him with rulers today.
Discuss the end of Abu Muslim Khurasani.
Introduce al-Mahdi and review his measures against heretics, zindiqs and false claimants to prophethood and his wars with the Romans.
Introduce al-Hadi, his role against heresy, rebellion and the founding of the Idrisid state.
Introduce Harun al-Rashid and review the main events of his reign.
Describe the Barmakids and their role in the Abbasid caliphate.
Review his relations with the Romans, the features of his age and his character.
Introduce al-Amin and explain the causes of the dispute and civil war with al-Mamun.
Describe al-Mamun's reign, religious policy, conquests and cultural and educational progress.
Explain why Baghdad was called the bride of cities and its role as a centre of learning.
Discuss the issue of the createdness of the Quran.
Describe key events and campaigns of al-Mutasim and the rise and effects of Mutazilites.
Describe the influence of Turks in administration and army.
Describe al-Wathiq and the role of centrifugal tribes and forces and the gradual decline of Mutazilites.
Comment on al-Mutawakkil's reign, the fall of Mutazilites, Turkish dominance and centrifugal forces.
Briefly introduce the later Abbasid caliphs and the features of the decline.
Critically assess the failed policies of the declining caliphs.
Introduce the independent states that arose.
Introduce the caliphs under the Buwayhid and Seljuk control (945 to 1129) and discuss the Buwayhids' conduct.

subtopics.title: Revival attempts and the fall of Baghdad

outcomes.text: Describe events of al-Nasir li-Din Allah, al-Zahir's reforms and al-Mustansir's services.
Comment on the fall of Baghdad.
Discuss the founding of the Buwayhid state and its famous rulers.
Discuss the Ghaznavid state and its relations with the Abbasids.
Discuss the founding, rise and fall of the Seljuk state, its main rulers, Nizam al-Mulk Tusi and scholars of the period.
Introduce the Fatimid caliphate and its distinguishing features, and other small independent states.
Introduce the Ayyubid state, the life and achievements of Salahuddin Ayyubi.
Explain the causes, main events and timeline, and results of the Crusades.
Introduce the Mongols and the causes of their attack on the Khwarazm state and on Baghdad.
Discuss the results of the Mongol invasion and the destruction of Baghdad.

units.title: Strand B: System of Government and Administration

topics.title: Government and administration under the Abbasids

outcomes.text: Define the terms caliph and sultan.
Describe the central administrative bodies of the Abbasid caliphate.
Discuss the powers and duties of the caliph and of the chief minister.
Describe provincial administration and the development, powers and duties of the sultan.
Discuss the financial system and revenue sources, and the tax system.
Describe the army's structure and organisation, and the duties of the police.
Define civilisation and culture.
Explain cultural progress in arts and architecture.
Explain the roles of Harun al-Rashid and al-Mamun in literature and learning.
Discuss cultural diversity, openness and tolerance in the Abbasid age.

units.title: Strand D: Growth of Knowledge and Arts

subtopics.title: Sciences and the House of Wisdom

outcomes.text: Explain progress in mathematics, medicine, astronomy and other sciences under the Abbasids.
Introduce leading Abbasid scholars and scientists and their contributions.
Introduce the House of Wisdom and its role in scientific progress.

units.title: Strand A: Introduction, Events and Developments

topics.title: Arrival of Islam in Spain and the Umayyad state

subtopics.title: Spain before and at Islam's arrival

outcomes.text: Describe Spain's geography when Islam arrived.
Comment on its political, social and economic conditions before Islam.
Describe Tariq ibn Ziyad's invasion in detail.
Introduce the main rulers of Andalusia before the Umayyad caliphate.
Describe Spain's political state before Umayyad rule.
Describe Abd al-Rahman al-Dakhil's early life, entry into Spain and reasons for his success.
Draw lessons from his ambition, determination and planning.
Comment on the Umayyad state of Andalusia as founded by him.

subtopics.title: Hisham I, al-Hakam I and Abd al-Rahman II

outcomes.text: Comment on Hisham I's life, character, style of rule and religious policy.
Explain al-Hakam I's difficulties and the policies he used to overcome them.
Describe Abd al-Rahman II and his role in forming a new civilisation from local and Arab cultures.
Describe the conditions of Spain under Amir Muhammad.
Discuss the life and rule of al-Mundhir ibn Muhammad.
Discuss events of Amir Abdullah's reign.
Describe Abd al-Rahman al-Nasir's life.
Discuss why he is called Spain's most successful ruler and why he took the title caliph.
Analyse how he met threats from the Fatimid caliphate.
Review his achievements and the role of the judiciary in his reign.

subtopics.title: Al-Hakam II, Hisham II and al-Mansur

outcomes.text: Introduce al-Hakam II, his promotion of knowledge and arts, relations with Christian states, educational activities and war policy.
Introduce Hisham II and events at his accession.
Analyse the claim that the real ruler was the chamberlain al-Mansur; describe his role and achievements.
Comment on the state under Abd al-Malik ibn Mansur and Abd al-Rahman Sanjul's appointment.
Introduce the Almoravids and Yusuf ibn Tashfin, his role in Andalusia and campaigns against the Christians.
Discuss the Almoravids after Yusuf and their decline.
Introduce the Almohads, their rulers (Abd al-Mumin and others), their role in Africa and Spain and Abu Yusuf Yaqub's role in the Crusades.

subtopics.title: Granada and the expulsion of Muslims

outcomes.text: Discuss Granada's role as the last centre of Muslim rule in Spain, its rulers and government.
Describe the expulsion of Muslims from Spain, its results and its causes.

subtopics.title: Decline of the Umayyads and small states

outcomes.text: Describe the end of the caliphate centre and the rise of independent states.
Discuss the rise of Christian states in the north-east.
Introduce the Ottoman Empire, list sultans in order and mention major conquests.
Discuss the appointment of Muhammad ibn Hisham al-Mahdi as caliph and the reigns of Sulayman al-Mustain and later caliphs.
Review events of the decline era and analyse the causes of the Umayyad fall in Spain.

units.title: Strand B: System of Government and Administration

outcomes.text: Describe the Spanish system: caliph, sultan, state, police, judiciary and finance.
Discuss the reasons Spanish rulers took the title caliph.
Explain key administrative posts: chamberlain, minister and council.
Describe the finance system and revenue sources.
Review the army's role in maintaining Muslim power.

topics.title: Cultural and intellectual progress in Spain

outcomes.text: Introduce notable scientists in medicine, chemistry and surgery.
Review Spanish Muslims' services to codifying jurisprudence and legislation.
Identify notable authors and scholars and their works.

units.title: Strand D: Growth of Knowledge and Arts

outcomes.text: Describe research in geography and astronomy.
Discuss discoveries in science and medicine and progress in botany and chemistry.
Describe new methods in farming and agriculture.

units.title: Strand E: Islamic Civilisation and Culture in Spain

topics.title: Islamic civilisation and culture in Spain

outcomes.text: Explain the distinct features of Islamic civilisation in Spain.
Explain the features of art and architecture.
Discuss scientific progress and educational institutions in Spain.
Discuss intellectual and scholarly progress.
Review the effects of Spain's Islamic civilisation on Europe.
